note.question: How does a method to reduce the discrepancy by using the sample variances of aggregated sales data?
note.overview: The bullwhip effect is a phenomenon commonly observed in supply chains. It describes how demand variance amplifies from a downstream site to an upstream site due to demand information distortion. Two different bullwhip effect measures have been used in the literature.
